implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure marks the threshold breach in substantive shareholding and activates the acquirer's obligation to make a public announcement of intent within four working days; counsel must advise on the 90-day tender offer window and potential open offer valuation methodology.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure filing on acquisition of substantial stakes; threshold triggers public announcement and open offer.
Acquirer must make public announcement within 4 working days of crossing 25% threshold or such acquisition reaching 25% + 1 share.
Open offer mechanics: price determined by independent valuers using specified methodologies (EPS, NTA, market price average).
Board approval and convening of general meetings for substantial shareholder actions; director disqualification if acquirer intends board control.
Acquirer permitted to acquire up to 5% shares without triggering open offer if conditions met (e.g., stock exchange, recognised intermediary acquisition).

framework.ref: NSE Listing Rules (Ashapura Minechem Limited's listing agreement)
framework.note: Continuous disclosure requirements; acquirer must file EPS, shareholding pattern, and board composition changes post-acquisition.
Acquirer must ensure no unpublished price-sensitive information (UPSI) is traded; material non-public information embargo on specified persons.

headline: Chetan Navnitlal Shah files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Ashapura Minechem Limited
sum: Chetan Navnitlal Shah has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Ashapura Minechem Limited. The filing triggers mandatory takeover code obligations under SEBI's acquisition and takeover framework.
detail: Chetan Navnitlal Shah has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, in respect of Ashapura Minechem Limited. This filing is the statutory mechanism by which an acquirer notifies the stock exchange and the public of a crossing of the 25% threshold (or relevant slab under Regulation 31) in voting rights. The disclosure triggers a cascade of obligations: public announcement within the prescribed timeline, open offer price determination by independent valuers, and board approval processes. The filing was made to NSE on 6 July 2026.
